About Northwind Supply

We started in a garage in Portland in 2016, after one too many jackets failed on a winter approach. The first Ridgeline was made because we could not find one we trusted, and we made fourteen of them before we made one we would sell.

We write plainly and we do not oversell. You will not find exclamation marks on this site, or countdown timers, or a sale that runs permanently. If a product has a limitation we say so, because the people who buy from us are experienced enough to notice when they are being handled.

Everything is field tested before it reaches the shop, by people who are not paid to like it. When something fails that test we do not ship it, which is why the range is small and why it changes slowly.

We are eleven people. We answer our own email.
